facts.business: Shanti Gold International Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and trading of gold and silver jewelry.

segments.name: Manufacturing and trading of gold and silver jewelry

auditor.name: J. Kala & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matters: (1) Uncertain tax matters pending litigations under direct and indirect tax laws involving significant judgement; (2) Inventory existence and valuation including change in inventory cost formula from FIFO to Weighted Average Cost (WAC) applied retrospectively.

key_risks: Uncertain tax matters pending litigations under direct tax and various indirect tax laws with significant judgement required for possible outcomes
Inventory valuation involves consideration of purity, weight, making charges and assessment of net realisable value
Change in inventory cost formula from FIFO to Weighted Average Cost (WAC) applied retrospectively requiring significant management judgement
facts.related_party_note: No Loans or Advances in the nature of loans are granted to promoters, directors, KMPs and the related parties either severally or jointly with any other person except as disclosed in Note 32 to Financial Statement under related parties.
